description: Meeting recovery workflow for declined one-on-one meetings with structured detection, triage, and rescheduling recommendations.
condition: A newly declined one-on-one meeting is detected in my calendar or inbox responses.
name: Reschedule Declined 1:1

steps.label: Collect recent decline signals
steps.prompt: Review recent calendar responses and meeting-related emails since the last run. Identify decline actions tied to meeting invitations.

steps.label: Filter to valid 1:1 candidates
steps.prompt: Keep only meetings that are true one-on-one sessions (organizer + one attendee), excluding room/resource-only scenarios and group meetings.

steps.label: Build meeting context
steps.prompt: For each declined 1:1, capture key context: subject, organizer, attendee, original date/time, duration, timezone, and whether this appears to be a recurring series.

steps.label: Resolve participants and constraints
steps.prompt: Resolve both participants to canonical identities and gather scheduling constraints including working hours, conflicts, and out-of-office blocks.

steps.label: Generate recovery options
steps.prompt: Find the best 3 replacement slots within the next 7 business days that fit both calendars, preserving original duration and timezone when possible. Rank by earliest viable and minimal disruption.

steps.label: Draft reschedule message
steps.prompt: Compose a concise draft message proposing the 3 options and asking for confirmation. Keep it ready for review only; do not send automatically.

steps.label: Publish summary
steps.prompt: Return a compact summary listing each declined 1:1 and its proposed slots, plus the draft text for each thread.
